_note: Per-(HW x model) overlay: overrides the GB10 HW profile for this 512-expert compressed-tensors checkpoint. Model wins over the HW profile; explicit env still wins over both.
_note_max_context_tokens: coder-next is served with runtime.maxContextTokens=32768 (in config.serve.codernext.json, not here — the overlay carries env-style flags, not serve-config fields). That ceiling ALSO sizes the cuDNN SDPA prefill graphs (CudnnSdpaPrefill::setMaxSeqLen tracks it via ServingSession::ensureServingState), so raising it there both admits longer prompts AND keeps them on the fast fused-flash path. Real Claude Code requests are ~24k tokens; 8192 rejected every turn.

MIMIRMIND_GROUPED_MOE.effect: FP4-TC grouped MoE path. The blocked device-driven grouped kernels scale catastrophically at 512 experts (rt.gather ~5.4s/chunk, moe.gemm ~71s/forward -> TTFT 35-76s). TC path: TTFT ~2.3s, decode 28 tok/s, AND lower peak mem (drops the blocked bank: 54.5GB vs 57GB).

MIMIRMIND_F32_TC_PREFILL.effect: OFF. The F32->BF16 TF32-TC prefill GEMM (matmul_bf16_gemm_tf32_tc) illegal-accesses on this checkpoint at large prefill. The HW profile has it apply:true value:1 (validated on qwen3.6, model-blind); this overlay pins it off for coder-next.

MIMIRMIND_ATTN_CUDNN_PAGED.effect: ON. Routes the serving paged-prefill full-attention through the cuDNN 9 SDPA fused-flash path instead of the CUDA-core paged-causal kernel. Only a win now that the cuDNN cap tracks maxContextTokens (was hardcoded 8192): head_dim=256 attention 22714-tok call 13623ms->179ms; end-to-end 22k prefill 240s->84.5s. Needs kvDtype F32/FP16/FP8 (coder-next serving kv=fp8, ok).

MIMIRMIND_PREFILL_CHUNK.effect: Prefill chunk = 8192 tokens (default 512). The cuDNN paged-prefill re-gathers the whole paged-KV prefix into a contiguous buffer every chunk (O(n^2) across chunks); bigger chunks mean far fewer re-gathers while staying memory-bounded (8192-row scratch, unlike a full single-chunk 32768). 22k prefill 84.5s (chunk 512) -> 53.2s (chunk 8192), = 240s->53s (4.5x) end-to-end vs the pre-cuDNN-fix baseline. Recall 3/3 unchanged.
